data.explanation: This is an order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) for a Deutschlandticket subscription, not a bill requiring immediate action. The ticket starts on 1 January 2026 and costs €63.00 per month, debited automatically at the start of each month. The subscription runs indefinitely and can be cancelled monthly, but the cancellation must reach MVB by the 10th of a month to end that same month. If MVB raises the price later, you'll get at least six weeks' notice and may then decide to cancel; the app will show the cancellation window when that happens. No action is needed right now beyond keeping the linked account funded.
